subject.title: feat: generic session discussion seam with Control UI panel

question: Should OpenClaw permanently own a single-provider public session-discussion SDK and gateway contract, rather than keeping this integration-specific or plugin-local?
rationale: The patch adds a new plugin SDK entrypoint and additive protocol methods that will become an external compatibility contract; code review alone cannot decide whether this is the intended long-term core seam.

options.title: Sponsor the generic core seam
options.body: Accept the public SDK and gateway direction after the lifecycle and availability defects are repaired.

options.title: Keep discussion integration plugin-local
options.body: Avoid adding the permanent core SDK and protocol surface until multiple integrations demonstrate a shared requirement.

options.title: Request a narrower contract proposal
options.body: Pause this PR and define ownership, multi-provider behavior, and lifecycle semantics before exposing the API.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the generic core seam
recommendation.body: Accept the public SDK and gateway direction after the lifecycle and availability defects are repaired.

likelyOwner.reason: The current implementation series and API proposal are authored by steipete, making them the clearest available routing candidate for the product-contract decision.
